forbidden.name: nothing-imports-app
forbidden.comment: The Next.js app/routing layer (src/app) is the top layer: it composes everything else and nothing imports it back. Phrased as 'anything outside src/app must not import src/app' rather than enumerating the lower layers, so a NEW source directory is governed automatically without anyone remembering to add it here.

forbidden.name: not-to-dev-dep
forbidden.comment: Production source must not import a devDependency (a test util, a build tool). Those are absent from a production install, so this would crash in prod. Move the dependency, or the code.

$comment: The Payload layer map, minus the pure-logic floor. That rule is rendered per project from the declared pureLogicRoots, because the floor is the one genuinely project-shaped part of an architecture contract and a project may not own this file to state it.
